title: Record the local install_security error class and HTTP status when a federation attestation ends with localInstallFailed
outcome: When Central's local install of an authenticated peer context fails, the attestation observation keeps a fixed error class and HTTP status for that attempt, with no raw error message. A run of localInstallFailed attempts, like DL560's attempts 1–7 after restart #3, can then be classified after the fact.
acceptance: The install_security failure branch records a fixed local install error class and the HTTP status, for example 423, 500 or 409, in the existing attestation observation. The accepted-heartbeat fields are null, the existing owner fences are respected, and no raw error.message is recorded.
A regression test drives each failure class through that branch and asserts the recorded class and status, and the review pair is clean.
